name: [💵] Shred The Cash
desc:
💰 Welcome to Shred A Billion!
A massive vault of cash is waiting—how much can you shred?

✋ Scoop up bills from a giant bank vault
🗑️ Feed your shredder and turn cash into earnings
⬆️ Boost your collecting power, speed and shredder
🪣 Unlock tools like the Bucket, Shovel and Vacuum
🎒 Upgrade your backpack to haul even more bills
🌈 Look out for rare Rainbow Cash worth a lot
👥 Bring up to 4 friends and tackle the pile together

🎮 Play on Desktop, Mobile & Tablet

llm.loop: scoop bills from a giant vault -> feed the shredder for earnings -> upgrade collecting power, tools and backpack -> find rare rainbow cash
llm.objectives: shred as much cash as possible and grow earnings
llm.progression: tool unlocks (bucket, shovel, vacuum), backpack capacity, collect speed, rare cash tiers
llm.instructions: scoop bills, feed the shredder, upgrade power/speed/backpack, unlock tools, bring up to 4 friends
unique: cash-shredding fantasy as the sell action
llm.thumbnails: first-person hand feeding cash into a shredder, a vault full of green bills, a rare 1% rainbow bill
llm.complexity_notes: one vault map, pile/pickup system, shredder sink, upgrade shop
